tldr: 台股5月寫歷史新猷：加權指數5/29大漲1,096點（+2.51%）收歷史新高44,732.94點，全月勁揚約5,806點，外資強力匯入推升。
COMPUTEX 2026將於6/2開展（黃仁勳6/1主題演講），使AI與先進製程／封裝供應鏈在6月持續主導盤面。
市場過熱使券商資金吃緊、短票利率走揚，引發央行轉趨保守的揣測；新台幣5月則大升6.98%，創36年最大單月升幅。
美股締造新高（道瓊約51,032點）、Fed維持3.5–3.75%不變；市場聚焦本週五美國5月非農與中東牽動的油價／通膨風險。
彙整提醒：今日預抓管線失效，本期以即時搜尋重建，建議資料源修復後重跑校核。

items.title_zh: 台股5/29收歷史新高44,732.94點、漲2.51% 外資強力買超
items.title_en: TAIEX closes at record 44,732.94, up 2.51%, as foreign buying surges (Fri 2026-05-29)
items.summary_zh: 台股最近一個交易日收盤改寫歷史新高，加權指數大漲1,096.50點（+2.51%）至44,732.94點，成交量逾新台幣1.8兆元。三大法人同步站買方：本週外資買超約1,652.42億元、投信連續第六週加碼（94.67億元）、自營商翻為回補（90.55億元），合計買超約1,837.65億元。統計5月單月，外資買超約2,362.11億元、投信加碼1,739.24億元。漲勢由AI與半導體權值股領軍，並受惠新台幣轉強帶動的外資大量匯入。後續須觀察天量能否延續，以及COMPUTEX題材的續航力。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index ended the last trading session at an all-time closing high, climbing 1,096.50 points (+2.51%) to 44,732.94 on turnover above NT$1.8 trillion. All three institutional groups were net buyers: foreign investors bought a net NT$165.2 billion for the week, investment trusts added for a sixth straight week (NT$9.5bn) and dealers swung back to net buying (NT$9.1bn), for a combined weekly net purchase near NT$183.8 billion. For May, foreign investors net-bought about NT$236.2 billion and trusts NT$173.9 billion. The rally was powered by AI/semiconductor leadership and heavy foreign inflows tied to a strengthening NT dollar.

items.title_zh: 台股5月大漲約5,806點 法人估6月有望挑戰46,000點
items.title_en: TAIEX up ~5,806 points in May; institutions see a push toward 46,000 in June
items.summary_zh: 台股5月繳出歷來數一數二的強勁月線，指數勁揚約5,806點、收在歷史高檔區。本地媒體引述法人看法，預期多頭可望延續至6月，COMPUTEX（6/2–6/5）與蘋果WWDC題材接力催化，部分機構認為有機會挑戰46,000點，操作區間約落在42,000至46,000點。惟法人提醒，近期漲幅又大又快，短線恐出現震盪，建議投資人保留資金彈性。布局方向以AI供應鏈中的先進製程、先進封裝與高速傳輸族群為優先，並留意指數高檔的回測風險與類股輪動節奏。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's market posted one of its strongest-ever months, with the index advancing roughly 5,806 points in May to finish at record territory. Strategists quoted by local media expect the uptrend to continue into June, with COMPUTEX (June 2–5) and Apple's WWDC providing back-to-back catalysts; several forecast a possible challenge of the 46,000 level, with a working range of about 42,000–46,000. They caution, however, that gains have been large and fast, so short-term volatility is likely and investors should keep some cash flexibility. Advanced process, advanced packaging and high-speed transmission names within the AI chain are flagged as priority positioning.

items.title_zh: COMPUTEX題材引爆 台股5/25狂飆1,376點收史高43,644點
items.title_en: COMPUTEX-fuelled rally drove the index to a record 43,644 on 2026-05-25
items.summary_zh: 展前COMPUTEX題材引爆全面攻勢：5月25日加權指數狂飆1,376點，收在當時歷史新高43,644點，面板三雄漲停、被動元件齊噴。該交易日凸顯AI硬體敘事已自晶片擴散至零組件、面板與機器人供應鏈。隨輝達Vera Rubin平台與「實體AI／機器人」成為焦點主軸，資金積極輪動至供應鏈受惠股，為其後5月下旬的歷史新高行情鋪路，也顯示展會題材的事件驅動動能。投資人須留意題材兌現後的獲利了結賣壓，以及展會期間實際訂單與產品宣示能否支撐評價。
items.summary_en: Ahead of the show, COMPUTEX themes ignited a broad advance: on May 25 the TAIEX surged 1,376 points to close at a then-record 43,644, with display "big three" panel makers limit-up and passive-component shares spiking. The session illustrated how the AI hardware narrative has broadened beyond chips into components, panels and robotics suppliers as the trade show approached. With Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform and physical-AI/robotics as headline themes, money rotated aggressively into supply-chain beneficiaries, setting the stage for the late-May record run that followed and underscoring event-driven momentum heading into the June exhibition week.

items.title_zh: COMPUTEX 2026 六月2日登場、規模創紀錄 黃仁勳6/1開講
items.title_en: COMPUTEX 2026 opens June 2 with record scale; Huang keynotes June 1
items.summary_zh: 亞洲旗艦科技展COMPUTEX將於6月2日至5日在台北舉行，除南港展覽館外重返世貿一館，吸引33國約1,500家企業、約6,000個攤位參展，刷新歷年紀錄。輝達執行長黃仁勳6月1日發表GTC Taipei主題演講，高通、英特爾、Marvell執行長接力；5月20日抵台的超微執行長蘇姿丰已宣布在台灣科技體系投資逾100億美元。展會首設AI機器人展區，集結上銀、所羅門、元太等逾180家企業，凸顯「實體AI」與機器人將與先進半導體並列為下一個主戰場。台股相關供應鏈題材後續可望續熱。
items.summary_en: Asia's flagship tech show runs June 2–5 in Taipei, returning to the TWTC Hall 1 alongside Nangang and drawing a record ~1,500 exhibitors from 33 countries across some 6,000 booths. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang delivers a GTC-Taipei keynote on June 1, with Qualcomm, Intel and Marvell chiefs to follow; AMD CEO Lisa Su, who arrived May 20, has announced over US$10 billion of investment in Taiwan's tech ecosystem. The show debuts an AI-robotics zone with 180+ firms (Hiwin, Solomon, E Ink), spotlighting physical AI and robotics as the next battleground alongside advanced semiconductors.

items.title_zh: 輝達Q1營收816億美元、年增85% AI資料中心需求爆發（5/21公布）
items.title_en: Nvidia Q1 revenue hits US$81.6bn, up 85%, on AI data-center demand (reported 2026-05-21)
items.summary_zh: 輝達公布單季營收816.2億美元，年增85%，其中資料中心營收752億美元（年增92%），約占總營收92%，再創新高，凸顯AI基礎建設需求強勁不墜。執行長黃仁勳形容AI「工廠」是人類史上最大規模的基礎建設擴張，並預測推論（inference）需求將出現「十億倍」成長，推論料占2026年整體AI算力約三分之二。儘管財報優於預期，盤後股價一度走跌。此一結果對供應輝達次世代平台的台灣晶片、封裝與伺服器供應鏈是直接利多，後續拉貨動能與毛利率變化值得追蹤。
items.summary_en: Nvidia reported quarterly revenue of US$81.62 billion, up 85% year over year, with data-center revenue of US$75.2 billion (+92%) making up about 92% of the total — a fresh record underscoring relentless AI-infrastructure demand. CEO Jensen Huang said AI "factories" represent the largest infrastructure build-out in history and predicted a "billion-fold" rise in inference demand, with inference set to account for roughly two-thirds of 2026 AI compute. Shares slipped after hours despite the beat. The results are a direct positive for Taiwan's chip, packaging and server supply chain, which feeds Nvidia's next-generation platforms.

items.title_zh: Vera Rubin採台積電3nm＋CoWoS-L＋HBM4 在台產能將翻倍
items.title_en: Vera Rubin platform built on TSMC 3nm + CoWoS-L + HBM4; Taiwan output to double
items.summary_zh: 輝達最新Vera Rubin NVL72平台採用台積電第三代3奈米製程與CoWoS-L封裝，並首度支援8層HBM4高頻寬記憶體；整套系統由約130萬個零組件構成（72顆Rubin GPU、36顆Vera CPU），能源效率較前代提升約10倍。黃仁勳表示，為迎接Vera Rubin量產，輝達在台製造AI超級電腦的產能將翻倍，MGX生態系夥伴已增至約150家。相關揭露強化台灣在AI先進製程與封裝的核心地位；黃仁勳並指資料中心支出將由今年約1兆美元，朝本世紀末3兆至4兆美元規模邁進，台廠長線受惠輪廓清晰。
items.summary_en: Nvidia's new Vera Rubin NVL72 platform uses TSMC's third-generation 3nm process with CoWoS-L packaging and, for the first time, supports eight-layer HBM4 high-bandwidth memory — a system of about 1.3 million components (72 Rubin GPUs and 36 Vera CPUs) with roughly 10x the energy efficiency of its predecessor. Huang said Nvidia will double its AI-supercomputer manufacturing capacity in Taiwan to ready Vera Rubin for volume production, and that its MGX ecosystem partners have grown to about 150 companies. The disclosures reinforce Taiwan's central role in advanced process and packaging for AI, with data-center spend seen rising from ~US$1tn toward US$3–4tn.

items.title_zh: 黃仁勳供應鏈「點名」 帶動台廠載板、PCB與組裝族群
items.title_en: Huang's supply-chain "name-checks" lift Taiwan ABF/PCB and assembly names
items.summary_zh: 隨COMPUTEX逼近，黃仁勳公開點名輝達台灣夥伴再度牽動盤面，據報其MGX背板名單新增臻鼎與可成，分析師並點名鴻海、廣達等「老AI」組裝廠為COMPUTEX受惠族群。此一模式顯示，黃仁勳每次現身都會重塑市場對先進封裝、高層數PCB／ABF載板、散熱與伺服器ODM等次世代AI平台供應鏈的布局。隨Vera Rubin放量，能滿足嚴苛散熱與訊號完整性要求的供應商，2026年訂單能見度有望提升；惟投資人宜區分已確認的設計導入（design-win）與情緒性的題材波動，避免追高。
items.summary_en: As COMPUTEX approached, Jensen Huang's public references to Nvidia's Taiwan partners again moved the market, with reports that his MGX backplane lineup added Zhen Ding and Catcher, while analysts also pointed to "old-AI" assemblers such as Hon Hai (Foxconn) and Quanta among COMPUTEX beneficiaries. The pattern shows how each Huang appearance reshapes positioning across advanced packaging, high-layer PCB/ABF substrates, thermal solutions and server ODMs that underpin next-generation AI platforms. With Vera Rubin ramping, suppliers able to meet stringent thermal and signal-integrity demands stand to gain order visibility into 2026, though investors should distinguish confirmed design-wins from sentiment-driven moves.

items.title_zh: 13家金控2026首季賺1,882億元、年增約31% 創同期新高
items.title_en: 13 financial holdings earn record NT$188.2bn in Q1 2026, up ~31%
items.summary_zh: 台灣13家上市金控2026年第一季稅後純益合計約1,882億元，年增約31%，多達8家改寫同期新高。亮眼季度反映資本市場暢旺、銀行與壽險獲利穩健，以及投資收益改善。整體而言，金融業獲利基底強勁，惟新台幣大幅轉強，使壽險業下半年的避險成本與匯兌風險再受關注。累計獲利與每股盈餘（EPS）雙冠王由富邦金拿下，壽險比重較高的金控在獲利前段班占有顯著位置。後續須觀察匯率波動對壽險淨值與避險策略的影響，以及股市行情對證券、投信子公司手續費收入的貢獻延續性。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's 13 listed financial-holding companies posted combined first-quarter after-tax profit of about NT$188.2 billion, up roughly 31% year over year, with as many as eight setting same-period records. The strong quarter reflected buoyant capital markets, resilient banking and life-insurance earnings, and improved investment returns. The results frame a robust earnings backdrop for the sector even as a sharply stronger NT dollar revives questions about hedging costs for insurers later in the year. Fubon led on both cumulative profit and EPS, with life-insurance-heavy groups featuring prominently among the top performers.

items.title_zh: 金控3月獲利中信稱王、富邦雙冠 中東變數壓抑單月表現
items.title_en: CTBC tops March profit; Fubon takes the double crown
items.summary_zh: 在中東緊張引發股債震盪下，13家金控3月獲利縮減至逾434億元。中信金以75.77億元勇奪單月獲利王，台新新光金以60.7億元居次、國泰金50.3億元第三；富邦金則穩居累計獲利與EPS「雙冠王」。單月獲利回落，顯示地緣政治與市場波動會透過交易部位與壽險投資損益直接傳導至金控獲利，即使在創高的季度亦然。相關數據強化「獲利強勁但波動偏大」的產業基調，也為年中除息行情前的選股提供觀察依據；後續地緣與匯率變數對單月獲利的擾動仍須留意。
items.summary_en: Amid stock-and-bond volatility driven by Middle-East tensions, the 13 financial holdings' March profit shrank to a little over NT$43.4 billion. CTBC Financial claimed the single-month profit crown at NT$7.58 billion, followed by Taishin-Shin Kong at NT$6.07 billion and Cathay at NT$5.03 billion, while Fubon held the cumulative profit and EPS "double crown." The monthly dip illustrates how geopolitics and market swings feed directly into financial-holding earnings via trading and insurance investment results, even within a record quarter. The data reinforce a theme of strong but volatile sector profitability heading into mid-year dividend season.

items.title_zh: 保險業2026年起適用IFRS 17 重塑資產與獲利表達方式
items.title_en: Insurers adopt IFRS 17 from 2026, reshaping how assets and profits are reported
items.summary_zh: 自2026年起，台灣保險業正式適用IFRS 17公報，取消「金融資產覆蓋法」，並將部分金融資產重新指定為FVOCI（透過其他綜合損益按公允價值衡量）科目。此一變革改變了保險負債與投資損益反映於損益及淨值的方式，雖提升可比性，但也增加單期獲利判讀的複雜度。在新台幣大幅轉強之際，制度轉換使壽險業帳列獲利與淨值對市場及匯率變動更敏感，成為分析師與主管機關今年監控壽險業清償能力與資本適足的重點。投資人解讀壽險金控財報時，須留意會計基礎變動造成的損益與淨值波動。
items.summary_en: From 2026 Taiwan's insurance industry formally adopts the IFRS 17 accounting standard, abolishing the "financial-asset overlay" approach and reclassifying part of insurers' financial assets into FVOCI (fair value through other comprehensive income). The change alters how insurance liabilities and investment results flow through earnings and equity, improving comparability but adding complexity to period-to-period profit reads. Combined with a sharply stronger NT dollar, the transition makes insurers' reported profitability and net worth more sensitive to market and currency moves — a key consideration for analysts and for regulators monitoring solvency and capital adequacy across the life-insurance sector this year.

items.title_zh: 2026金控股利總額3,422億創高、對中曝險年減13%
items.title_en: Record NT$342.2bn in 2026 financial-holding dividends; China exposure down 13%
items.summary_zh: 台灣13家金控公布2026年股利總額達3,422億元、創歷史新高，其中9家現金殖利率突破4%，在除息旺季前吸引存股族目光，也是創高獲利季後的信心展現。另一方面，金融三業（銀行、保險、證券）對中國曝險年減13%，反映在兩岸與地緣不確定下持續的去風險（de-risking）操作。兩相對照，呈現金融業一面提高股東回報、一面收斂跨境風險的輪廓；惟在本地股市與貨幣同步轉強之際，獲利結構與資金配置的變化仍須持續觀察，殖利率與填息表現亦為投資人布局金融股的重要參考。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's 13 financial holdings have unveiled a record NT$342.2 billion in total 2026 dividends, with nine offering cash yields above 4% — a draw for income investors heading into ex-dividend season and a sign of confidence after a record-earnings quarter. Separately, the banking, insurance and securities sectors cut their China exposure by 13% year over year, reflecting ongoing de-risking amid cross-strait and geopolitical uncertainty. Together the items sketch a sector that is returning more capital to shareholders while trimming cross-border risk, even as a strong local market and currency reshape its earnings mix.

items.title_zh: 主動式ETF至2026年4月底達28檔、規模逼近5,000億元
items.title_en: Active ETFs swell to 28 funds and near NT$500bn by April 2026
items.summary_zh: 台灣主動式ETF至2026年4月底已擴張至28檔，合計規模突破近5,000億元，在法規鬆綁、選股靈活度提高後，成為資產管理業快速成長的新戰場。產品大致分為追求資本利得的「成長型」與強調穩定現金流的「高股息型」兩大主流，債券主動式ETF（第六碼為D）則補足固定收益選項。投信預期，隨2026年主題輪動加速，兼顧息收與成長的平衡型「股搭債」產品可望續吸買盤，成為財富管理重要趨勢。對追求收益的高資產與一般投資人而言，主動式ETF的費率、選股能力與績效續航，將是布局時的關鍵評估點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's actively managed ETF segment has expanded to 28 funds with combined assets topping nearly NT$500 billion as of end-April 2026, becoming a fast-growing new battleground for asset managers after regulatory easing widened stock-selection flexibility. Products split mainly into growth-oriented strategies chasing capital gains and high-dividend strategies emphasizing steady cash flow, with bond active ETFs (sixth-character "D") adding fixed-income options. Managers expect continued popularity in 2026 as theme rotation accelerates, with balanced "stock-plus-bond" or income-and-growth products positioned to manage volatility — a key wealth-management trend for income-seeking high-asset and retail clients alike.

items.title_zh: 金管會擬開放百年「連續受益人信託」 助高資產家族留財台灣
items.title_en: FSC to allow 100-year "successive-beneficiary trusts" to keep family wealth onshore
items.summary_zh: 金管會已與財政部、法務部完成跨部會研商，擬開放「連續受益人信託」，並訂定最長存續期間100年及課稅原則。依制度設計，後順位受益人於信託期間因契約條件成就而取得權利時，性質上不屬贈與或繼承，故不課徵贈與稅及遺產稅。此舉意在提供高資產家族長天期的傳承工具，協助財富長期留在台灣，是打造台灣成為亞洲資產管理中心政策的核心一環。對私人銀行與財管業者而言，百年信託可望開展家族辦公室、跨世代傳承規劃等高附加價值業務；後續立法與課稅細則的明確化，將決定制度落地的速度與實務應用範圍。
items.summary_en: The FSC, together with the Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Justice, has completed inter-agency study of a proposed "successive-beneficiary trust" with a maximum duration of 100 years, plus accompanying taxation principles. Under the design, later-ranked beneficiaries who acquire rights during the trust term — when contractual conditions are met — would not be treated as receiving a gift or inheritance, and so would not trigger gift or estate tax. The aim is to give high-asset families a long-horizon succession vehicle and to retain wealth in Taiwan, a centerpiece of the drive to build the island into an Asian asset-management hub.

items.title_zh: 高資產財管鬆綁上路 銀行加速擴建私人銀行平台
items.title_en: High-asset wealth rules loosened; banks build out private-banking platforms
items.summary_zh: 金管會鬆綁高資產客戶制度——包括刪除銀行申辦該業務的資產規模門檻、並放寬結構型金融債券銷售對象至專業投資人——已於農曆年前上路，估計至少有5家銀行將提出申請。符合資格的21家銀行中，已有12家開辦財富管理2.0。國泰世華等銀行正組建私銀團隊，專精債券、結構型商品、國外股票、基金、ETF、外匯、信託與傳承規劃，結合「財管2.0」與「信託2.0」提供高淨值家族一站式客製服務，使境內高資產資金的競爭更趨白熱化。後續各行私銀AUM成長、商品平台廣度與傳承顧問能量，將是觀察財管版圖消長的關鍵。
items.summary_en: The FSC's easing of its high-asset client framework — including removing the asset-size threshold for banks applying for the business and widening sales of structured financial bonds to professional investors — took effect around the Lunar New Year, with at least five banks expected to apply. Of 21 banks meeting the criteria, 12 already run Wealth Management 2.0 services. Banks such as Cathay United are assembling private-banking teams specializing in bonds, structured products, overseas equities, funds, ETFs, FX, trusts and succession, offering one-stop solutions that combine Wealth Management 2.0 with Trust 2.0 for high-net-worth families — intensifying competition for high-asset capital onshore.

items.title_zh: 金管會放寬主動式ETF投資單一公司上限 台積電迎活水
items.title_en: FSC raises single-issuer cap for active ETFs, channeling flows toward TSMC
items.summary_zh: 金管會放寬主動式ETF投資單一公司的持股上限，本地媒體形容此舉為權值獨大的台積電「引進活水」。此調整讓主動經理人能在不違反集中度限制下，更貼近對大型權值龍頭的高信心配置，提升追蹤或超越由少數AI／半導體股主導之指數的能力。對財管客戶而言，這擴大了主動策略的工具箱，但同時也使曝險更集中，凸顯在主動式ETF貨架快速擴張之際，商品適合度評估與分散配置的重要性。後續主動式ETF能否藉提高權值股配置繳出超額報酬，將牽動投信競爭與投資人對「主動」價值的認同。
items.summary_en: The FSC has relaxed the upper limit on how much an actively managed ETF may invest in a single company, a move local media frame as opening "fresh water" for TSMC given its dominant index weight. The change lets active managers more closely reflect high-conviction views on mega-cap leaders without breaching concentration limits, improving their ability to track or beat benchmarks crowded by a handful of AI/semiconductor names. For wealth clients, it broadens the toolkit of active strategies but also concentrates exposure, reinforcing the need for suitability checks and diversification alongside the rapid growth of Taiwan's active-ETF shelf.

items.title_zh: 2026遺產稅、贈與稅課稅級距調升 因CPI上漲12.42%達調整門檻
items.title_en: 2026 estate/gift-tax brackets adjusted upward as CPI rises 12.42%
items.summary_zh: 2026年台灣遺產稅與贈與稅的免稅額及各項扣除額維持不變，但因累計消費者物價指數（CPI）漲幅達12.42%的法定調整門檻，課稅級距隨之調升，使高資產族群稅負相對減輕——適用較高邊際稅率的金額門檻被往上拉寬。級距物價連動機制會定期更新門檻以抵銷通膨，今年觸發調整，意味相較於門檻不動，更多遺產或贈與金額落入較低稅率級距。會計師建議，高資產家族應在更新後的架構下，重新檢視逐年贈與與信託規劃，以有效運用各項扣除額、合法降低稅負。
items.summary_en: For 2026, Taiwan's estate- and gift-tax exemptions and deductions are unchanged, but the tax brackets have been adjusted because cumulative CPI growth reached the 12.42% threshold that triggers indexation — modestly easing the burden on high-asset families by widening the bands at which higher marginal rates apply. The indexation mechanism periodically updates bracket thresholds to offset inflation, and this year's trigger means more of an estate or gift falls into lower-rate bands than under static thresholds. Advisers say high-asset families should revisit lifetime-gifting and trust strategies to use deductions efficiently within the updated framework.
items.source_name: 自由電子報 地產天下

items.title_zh: 最低稅負免稅額750萬元 海外所得不論是否匯回均須申報
items.title_en: Minimum-tax exemption at NT$7.5m; overseas income must be reported regardless of repatriation
items.summary_zh: 依台灣最低稅負制（基本所得額），現行申報週期免稅額為750萬元；個人全年海外所得一旦超過100萬元即全數計入基本所得額，超過750萬元部分按20%課徵。關鍵在於，來自境外有價證券或基金的海外所得，須於「發生年度」申報（股票以交割日、基金以契約約定日認定），不論資金是否實際匯回台灣。此外，不同年度或不同類型的所得，其損失與利得不得互抵，是高資產投資人持有境外投資組合時的重要遵循要點。建議納稅人妥善留存交易與匯率紀錄，並就CFC股利併計、海外所得時點等議題預先規劃，以免短漏報衍生補稅與裁罰風險。
items.summary_en: Under Taiwan's Alternative Minimum Tax (AMT/basic income tax), the exemption threshold stands at NT$7.5 million for the current filing cycle; once annual overseas income exceeds NT$1 million it is fully included in basic income, with 20% applied to amounts above the NT$7.5m threshold. Crucially, overseas income from foreign securities or funds must be declared in the year it arises — based on settlement date for shares or contract-specified dates for funds — whether or not the money is actually repatriated to Taiwan. Gains and losses across different years or income types cannot be offset, a key compliance point for high-asset investors with offshore portfolios.

items.title_zh: 財政部明確「死亡前二年內贈與配偶財產」併計遺產 連續受益人信託訂課稅原則
items.title_en: MOF clarifies gifts to a spouse within two years of death; new-trust taxing principles set
items.summary_zh: 財政部發布作業原則，就「被繼承人死亡前二年內贈與配偶之財產併計遺產總額課徵遺產稅」明確規範：由各受贈人按比例負擔遺產稅，並在計算配偶剩餘財產差額分配請求權扣除額時，對稱增加扣除金額。同時，研議中的連續受益人信託（最長100年）亦訂有課稅原則——信託期間後順位受益人因條件成就取得之權利，不視為贈與或繼承。兩項措施一方面收緊對「死亡前移轉」的反避稅規範，一方面為高資產家族開啟長天期、課稅界定明確的傳承工具。實務上，家族在運用生前贈與與信託架構時，須將上述併計與課稅原則納入整體稅務規劃。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance has issued operating principles on including property gifted to a spouse within two years before death back into the gross estate for estate-tax purposes, specifying that each recipient bears the estate tax proportionally, with a symmetric increase in the deduction when computing the spouse's remaining-property difference-distribution claim. In parallel, the planned successive-beneficiary (up to 100-year) trust comes with agreed taxation principles under which rights acquired by later beneficiaries during the term are not treated as gift or inheritance. Together the moves tighten anti-avoidance around death-bed transfers while opening a long-horizon, tax-defined succession vehicle for high-asset families.

items.title_zh: 新台幣5月勁升約6.98% 創逾36年最大單月升幅
items.title_en: NT dollar logs biggest monthly gain in 36 years, up ~6.98% in May
items.summary_zh: 新台幣5月強勢走升，月底約收31.488元（單日升1.17角）；全月累計強升約2.088元、升幅約6.98%，創逾36年來最大單月升幅。升值動能來自台股迭創新高、美元走弱與外資大舉匯入（外資再買超751.05億元）。央行不樂見過度強勢，已安排政府基金與進口廠商等美元買盤對沖，以維持匯率穩定。出口產業承壓，機械公會理事長呼籲，若新台幣持續升值，廠商形同做白工，須有合理利潤才能投入研發與設備。後續匯率走向牽動出口競爭力、壽險匯兌損益與輸入性通膨，是央行季度理監事會前的關鍵變數。
items.summary_en: The New Taiwan dollar surged in May, closing the month around 31.488 per US dollar after a single-session gain of NT$0.117; for the month it strengthened about NT$2.088, or roughly 6.98% — its largest monthly appreciation in more than 36 years. The move was driven by record-breaking Taiwan equities, a weaker US dollar and heavy foreign inflows (foreign investors bought a further NT$75.1 billion). The central bank, wary of excessive strength, arranged offsetting US-dollar demand from government funds and importers to steady the rate. Exporters, including the machinery industry, warned that further appreciation erodes competitiveness.
items.source_name: 中央銀行 新台幣升值說明

items.title_zh: 台股爆量逼出券商錢荒、短票利率走揚 引發央行升息揣測（5/26）
items.title_en: Record turnover strains brokerage funding, stirs rate-hike talk (2026-05-26)
items.summary_zh: 台股成交量屢破兆元，使本土券商短期資金趨緊：商業本票發行量至4月達歷史新高4.3兆元，30天期本票利率攀至一年高點。券商資本相對日成交量偏小（元大659億元、凱基182億元），貸款使用率達6至7成，須靠發行票券與向銀行借款，支應融資餘額與ETF申購所需。有經濟學家認為，發行量創高且利率走升，恐促使央行最終調高基準利率——將股市熱潮與貨幣市場狀況直接連動。在央行季度理監事會前，短票利率走勢與央行措辭，成為研判資金面與升息風險的關鍵觀察點。
items.summary_en: A surge in Taiwan equity turnover — repeatedly above NT$1 trillion — has tightened short-term funding for local brokerages, with commercial-paper issuance hitting a record NT$4.3 trillion as of April and 30-day CP rates reaching one-year highs. Brokers, whose capital is small relative to daily volumes (Yuanta NT$65.9bn, KGI NT$18.2bn) and whose loan-utilization runs 60–70%, are issuing notes and tapping bank loans to fund margin financing and ETF subscriptions. One economist argued that record issuance and rising rates could eventually prompt the central bank to lift its benchmark — directly linking the equity boom to money-market conditions ahead of the CBC's quarterly meeting.

items.title_zh: Fed維持利率3.5–3.75%不變 結束降息循環、釋中性訊號
items.title_en: Fed holds at 3.5–3.75%, ending its cutting cycle and signalling a neutral stance
items.summary_zh: 美國聯準會（Fed）維持聯邦資金利率目標區間於3.5%–3.75%不變，在自2024年底以來累計約降息75個基點後暫停、結束此波降息循環；主席鮑爾示意當前政策已落於對中性利率的合理估計區間。稍早會議紀要顯示，官員對中東緊張升溫可能推升通膨保持戒心，部分官員甚至備妥在通膨壓力加劇時考慮升息。此「higher-for-longer、數據依賴」的立場，牽動全球利率預期、美元走向與風險偏好，並直接傳導至台灣的匯率、外資流向與股市評價。市場後續將緊盯美國通膨與就業數據，研判Fed政策路徑與台股資金行情的延續性。
items.summary_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve has held the federal-funds target range at 3.5%–3.75%, pausing after about 75 basis points of cuts since late 2024 and ending the recent easing cycle, with Chair Powell indicating policy is now within a reasonable estimate of neutral. Minutes from an earlier meeting showed officials wary that escalating Middle-East tensions could add to inflation, with some prepared to consider hikes if price pressures intensify. The "higher-for-longer, data-dependent" stance shapes global rate expectations, the US dollar's trajectory and risk appetite — all of which feed directly into Taiwan's currency, foreign flows and equity valuations.

items.title_zh: 美股締造新高、AI行情續航 道瓊逼近51,032點
items.title_en: Wall Street at record highs as AI rally rolls on; Dow near 51,032
items.summary_zh: 美股5月下旬攻抵歷史新高，道瓊工業指數上漲約363點（+0.72%）至約51,032點，由IBM（+12.9%）、Salesforce（+8.5%）與微軟（+5.5%）領漲，表現最弱者為沃爾瑪、嬌生與耐吉。市場一面評估AI行情的可持續性，一面關注中東原油供給風險及其通膨意涵。此波新高與推升台股的AI動能相互呼應，凸顯美國大型科技股情緒與台灣出口科技龍頭之間的緊密連動，也為COMPUTEX展會週營造偏多的國際背景。惟指數高檔下，後續經濟數據與企業財報若不如預期，全球股市的回檔風險亦需留意。
items.summary_en: U.S. equities pushed to record highs into late May, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average gaining about 363 points (+0.72%) to roughly 51,032, led by IBM (+12.9%), Salesforce (+8.5%) and Microsoft (+5.5%); weakest were Walmart, J&J and Nike. Markets are weighing how sustainable the AI rally is, alongside Middle-East oil-supply risk and its inflation implications. The record run mirrors the AI-driven strength powering Taiwan's market, reinforcing tight linkage between U.S. mega-cap tech sentiment and Taiwan's export-tech leaders — and setting an upbeat global backdrop into COMPUTEX week.

items.title_zh: 美國第一季GDP下修至1.6% Fed官員示警通膨風險
items.title_en: U.S. Q1 GDP revised down to 1.6%; Fed officials flag inflation risk
items.summary_zh: 美國政府第二次估計值將第一季GDP年化成長率下修至1.6%，低於初值的2%，也低於經濟學家認定的穩健水準，暗示成長動能趨緩。堪薩斯城聯準銀行總裁施密德（Jeff Schmid）形容通膨是經濟「最迫切」的風險，強化Fed審慎、數據依賴的立場。成長放緩與通膨僵固的組合，使利率前景更趨複雜，市場對後續數據的敏感度升高。對台灣等高度依賴貿易的經濟體而言，美國成長走緩會抑制出口展望，所幸AI資本支出仍是強力的抵銷力量。後續美國通膨與消費數據，將是研判全球景氣與政策走向的重點。
items.summary_en: The U.S. government's second estimate put first-quarter GDP at a 1.6% annualized pace, down from the initial 2% and below levels economists consider robust, hinting at a softer growth backdrop. Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid called inflation the "most pressing" risk to the economy, reinforcing the Fed's cautious, data-dependent posture. The mix of cooler growth and sticky-inflation concern complicates the rate outlook and keeps markets sensitive to incoming data. For trade-exposed economies like Taiwan, softer U.S. growth tempers the export outlook even as AI capex stays a powerful offset.

items.title_zh: 市場聚焦美國5月非農與中東油價 作為風險溫度計
items.title_en: Eyes on May U.S. payrolls and Middle-East oil as risk barometers
items.summary_zh: 投資人嚴陣以待本週五美國5月非農就業報告，視其為勞動市場韌性的關鍵試金石；若數據疲弱，恐再度引發對消費支出與景氣擴張可持續性的疑慮。同時，中東緊張仍是油價的擺盪因子，並進而牽動通膨與全球風險偏好，近週已數度引發股市與金融類股波動。對「就業數據＋地緣政治」的雙重關注，框定了全球市場的短線方向；對台灣而言，這些變數會透過外資布局、新台幣匯率與AI主導的股市動能傳導至本地盤面。投資人宜留意數據公布前後的波動放大，並控管追高風險。
items.summary_en: Investors are bracing for Friday's U.S. May nonfarm payrolls report as a key test of labor-market resilience; a weak print could revive worries about consumer spending and the durability of the expansion. At the same time, Middle-East tensions remain a swing factor for oil prices and, by extension, inflation and global risk appetite, having already driven bouts of equity and financial-sector volatility in recent weeks. The dual focus on jobs data and geopolitics frames near-term direction for global markets — and for Taiwan, where these inputs flow through to foreign positioning, the NT dollar and AI-led equity momentum.

items.title_zh: Fed以近乎一致票數維持利率3.5–3.75%
items.title_en: Fed holds rates at 3.5–3.75% in a near-unanimous vote
items.summary_zh: 聯準會FOMC以市場普遍預期的決定，維持基準利率於3.5%–3.75%區間，延續結束2024–25年降息循環後的暫停。官員強調數據依賴、無預設路徑，未來政策由通膨與勞動市場主導。
items.summary_en: In a widely expected decision, the Federal Open Market Committee voted to keep the benchmark federal-funds rate in a 3.5%–3.75% range, continuing the pause that ended its 2024–25 easing cycle. Officials have stressed a data-dependent, no-preset-path stance, with inflation and the labor market driving the outlook.

items.title_zh: 標普500盤中首破7,000點、Fed按兵後平收
items.title_en: S&P 500 briefly tops 7,000 as the Fed keeps rates steady
items.summary_zh: 標普500指數一度突破7,000點里程碑，隨後在Fed維持利率當日小幅平收，反映市場評價偏高、對每次政策訊號更趨敏感。
items.summary_en: The S&P 500 briefly surpassed the 7,000 milestone before closing little changed on a day the Fed held rates, reflecting markets that are richly valued and increasingly sensitive to each policy signal.

items.title_zh: 輝達締造AI驅動的紀錄季 盤後股價震盪
items.title_en: Nvidia posts record AI-driven quarter; shares wobble after hours
items.summary_zh: 輝達最新財報顯示資料中心營收在AI需求激增下主導營收結構，惟盤後股價走跌——提醒市場即便AI財報強勁，門檻也已墊高，財測與供給（HBM、先進封裝）受高度檢視。
items.summary_en: Nvidia's latest results showed data-center revenue dominating the mix on surging AI demand, yet the stock slipped after hours — a reminder that even strong AI earnings now face a high bar, with guidance and supply (HBM, advanced packaging) under intense scrutiny.

items.title_zh: 美股近歷史高 AI行情受油價與通膨考驗
items.title_en: U.S. stocks at records as AI rally is tested by oil and inflation
items.summary_zh: 美國主要指數5月下旬位於歷史高檔，投資人權衡AI行情的續航力，對照中東原油供給風險及其通膨衝擊，焦點轉向即將公布的就業數據。
items.summary_en: Major U.S. indexes sat near record highs late in May while investors gauged the AI rally's staying power against Middle-East oil-supply risk and its inflation impact, with attention turning to upcoming jobs data.
